notes: Adds searchable Clipboard source filtering in Resource Manager, persistent managed screenshots, source-path image handling, and a three-stage filter shortcut.
Makes Dynamic, Library, and Clipboard shortcuts configurable while preserving standard operating-system Command shortcuts.
Adds explicit Agent clipboard-content permission and rejects cross-origin browser calls, form-style writes, oversized bodies, and unsupported media types on the loopback API.
Clarifies Agent connection evidence, improves accessibility and settings persistence, and adds direct Resource Manager access from the tray menu.
